# Library Context Summary: simple_sql
# Generated by /eiffel.notes-prep on 2026-02-07

## Mission
High-level SQLite API for Eiffel providing a clean, contract-driven interface for database operations — from fluent query builders and streaming cursors to schema migration, FTS5 search, vector similarity, eager loading, and a lightweight ORM.

## Key Abstractions
| Class | Role |
|-------|------|
| SIMPLE_SQL_DATABASE | High-level SQLite facade: open, execute, query, transactions |
| SIMPLE_SQL_DATABASE_POOL | Cached connection reuse by file path |
| SIMPLE_SQL_RESULT | Eagerly-loaded container for all rows from a query |
| SIMPLE_SQL_ROW | Named-column data carrier for a single result row |
| SIMPLE_SQL_CURSOR | Lazy row-by-row iterator over query results |
| SIMPLE_SQL_CURSOR_ITERATOR | ITERATION_CURSOR adapter for across-loop syntax |
| SIMPLE_SQL_RESULT_STREAM | Memory-efficient streaming row processor |
| SIMPLE_SQL_PAGE | Cursor-based pagination container |
| SIMPLE_SQL_QUERY_BUILDER | Shared fluent builder infrastructure for SQL generation |
| SIMPLE_SQL_SELECT_BUILDER | Fluent SELECT with joins, soft deletes, streaming |
| SIMPLE_SQL_INSERT_BUILDER | Fluent INSERT with multi-row and returning-id |
| SIMPLE_SQL_UPDATE_BUILDER | Fluent UPDATE with SET clauses and arithmetic |
| SIMPLE_SQL_DELETE_BUILDER | Fluent DELETE with compound WHERE |
| SIMPLE_SQL_RAW_EXPRESSION | Marker preventing SQL escaping of raw strings |
| SIMPLE_SQL_PREPARED_STATEMENT | Prepared statement with parameter binding |
| SIMPLE_SQL_BATCH | Transactional bulk SQL with auto-commit |
| SIMPLE_SQL_PAGINATOR | Cursor-based keyset pagination builder |
| SIMPLE_SQL_SCHEMA | Runtime schema discovery via SQLite PRAGMAs |
| SIMPLE_SQL_TABLE_INFO | Aggregated table metadata container |
| SIMPLE_SQL_COLUMN_INFO | Column metadata with SQLite type affinity |
| SIMPLE_SQL_INDEX_INFO | Index metadata with origin classification |
| SIMPLE_SQL_FOREIGN_KEY_INFO | Foreign key constraint metadata |
| SIMPLE_SQL_MIGRATION | Bidirectional schema change unit |
| SIMPLE_SQL_MIGRATION_RUNNER | Ordered migration execution with rollback safety |
| SIMPLE_SQL_ERROR | Structured SQLite error with code classification |
| SIMPLE_SQL_ERROR_CODE | Enumerated SQLite error codes |
| SIMPLE_SQL_QUERY_MONITOR | N+1 query detector with SQL fingerprinting |
| SIMPLE_SQL_EAGER_LOADER | Batched IN-clause fetching preventing N+1 |
| SIMPLE_SQL_EAGER_RESULT | Combined main + related eager-loaded data |
| SIMPLE_SQL_JSON | SQLite JSON1 extension facade |
| SIMPLE_SQL_JSON_HELPERS | JSON TEXT/BLOB storage demonstrations |
| SIMPLE_SQL_FTS5 | FTS5 virtual table lifecycle and search |
| SIMPLE_SQL_FTS5_QUERY | Fluent FTS5 query builder with BM25 ranking |
| SIMPLE_SQL_VECTOR | Vector representation for embeddings |
| SIMPLE_SQL_VECTOR_STORE | Vector storage with similarity search |
| SIMPLE_SQL_SIMILARITY | Distance calculations for vector embeddings |
| SIMPLE_SQL_AUDIT | Automatic change tracking for tables |
| AUDIT_ENTRY | Immutable audit trail entry |
| SIMPLE_SQL_BACKUP | Database backup between memory and filesystem |
| SIMPLE_SQL_ONLINE_BACKUP | Incremental online backup with progress |
| SIMPLE_SQL_EXPORT | Multi-format export (CSV, JSON, SQL dump) |
| SIMPLE_SQL_IMPORT | Multi-format import with transactional safety |
| SIMPLE_SQL_REFLECTIVE_MAPPER | Bidirectional object-relational mapping via reflection |
| SIMPLE_SQL_REPOSITORY | Generic repository pattern for entities |
| SIMPLE_SQL_QUICK | Simplified zero-configuration API for beginners |
| SIMPLE_SQL_PRAGMA_CONFIG | Named PRAGMA profiles for performance tuning |
| AGENT_PART_COMPARATOR | Agent adapter bridging predicates to PART_COMPARATOR |
| SIMPLE_ORM | Object-Relational Mapping facade |
| SIMPLE_ORM_ENTITY | Base class for ORM entities with primary key handling |
| SIMPLE_ORM_FIELD | Column descriptor with type mapping and DDL generation |
| SIMPLE_ORM_REPOSITORY | Generic ORM repository for entity subclasses |

## Collaborator Relationships
- SIMPLE_SQL_DATABASE orchestrates SIMPLE_SQL_RESULT, SIMPLE_SQL_ROW, SIMPLE_SQL_ERROR for query execution
- SIMPLE_SQL_SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE_BUILDER inherit SIMPLE_SQL_QUERY_BUILDER for shared fluent infrastructure
- SIMPLE_SQL_MIGRATION_RUNNER manages an ordered list of SIMPLE_SQL_MIGRATION objects
- SIMPLE_SQL_EAGER_LOADER produces SIMPLE_SQL_EAGER_RESULT to prevent N+1 queries
- SIMPLE_SQL_FTS5 creates SIMPLE_SQL_FTS5_QUERY for fluent full-text search
- SIMPLE_SQL_VECTOR_STORE uses SIMPLE_SQL_VECTOR and SIMPLE_SQL_SIMILARITY for embeddings
- SIMPLE_SQL_PAGINATOR produces SIMPLE_SQL_PAGE containers
- SIMPLE_ORM_REPOSITORY works with SIMPLE_ORM_ENTITY and SIMPLE_ORM_FIELD for ORM operations

## External Dependencies
- ISE EiffelStore SQLite3 library (database engine)
- simple_mml (MML model types for specification contracts)
- SQLite JSON1 extension (for SIMPLE_SQL_JSON)
- SQLite FTS5 extension (for SIMPLE_SQL_FTS5)
- SQLite Backup API (for SIMPLE_SQL_ONLINE_BACKUP)

- Repo: https://github.com/simple-eiffel/simple_sql

## Note on Mock Applications
The src/ directory contains 5 mock app subdirectories (todo_app, cpm_app, habit_tracker, dms, wms) that are NOT core library classes — they are realistic applications used for mock-driven API development. Downstream note skills should process only the 44 core library files + 4 ORM files, excluding these app directories.
